A NOTE FROM INDIEK

Good music travels.

An independent, non-commercial fan journal sharing Korean music with listeners around the world.

A personal selection.

I made indiek to share Korean artists and songs I wish more people knew. The name is indiek, but the selection reaches across genres, labels and levels of fame.

This is a listening journal, not a ranking or a news feed. A song can belong here long after its release. Official music videos, live performances and release links give you a way to listen and keep exploring.

indiek is not affiliated with the featured artists, their labels, YouTube or Apple Music. There are no sales, affiliate links, subscriptions or paid placements on this site.

Get in touch.

For questions, factual corrections, credit updates, or requests concerning an image or other content, email gw@lumejs.com.

Include the page address and the material you are referring to. For an image request, please describe your connection to the work. Please avoid sending sensitive personal documents in an initial message.
